independence_evidence: Historic independent Japanese fashion and culture magazine founded by Fumihiro Hayashi in 1993; no corporate owner recorded.
qualifies_reason: Dune ceased publication in 2008 (issue 33); the 2026 distributor listings are vintage back issues from 1997-1999 sold by KD Presse, not new print issues.
what_it_is: Dune was a Tokyo fashion and culture magazine published from 1993 to 2008 that ran photography by figures such as Terry Richardson, Mario Sorrenti and Nan Goldin alongside features on designers and filmmakers. It is now collected as a vintage title; the KD Presse listings that generated the hint are back issues from the late 1990s. It would interest collectors of 1990s fashion photography rather than readers looking for a current magazine.
uncertainties: No official publisher site exists for the title today. The KD Presse products Dune 12-17 (published to the shop 2026-08-31) are dated Spring 1997 to Spring 1999 in their descriptions, so the distributor 'latest listing 2026-08 (17)' refers to a 1999 back issue. The successor title Libertin DUNE (2011) is a different magazine and was not assessed. City given as Tokyo on the basis of the magazine's documented Japanese base; the 2008 end date and issue count come from third-party sources.
